symbols.N_shard: All honest-source native sharding calls whose objects appear in or support the experiment, including published packets never prepared, warmup, eligible zero, failed candidate or later aborted history; may conservatively count every honest construction call.
symbols.N_prepared: All distinct authorized protected report contexts actually entering private preparation, H and non-H, including failed and aborted prefixes; report cohort R is only a subset.
symbols.C_init_L/C_init_R: Physical prepare_init calls per role, including transaction rollback recomputation. Helper first-input journal and Leader committed-transition lease fence do not cap physical work; uncommitted Leader recomputation can receive different peer responses.
symbols.C_finish_R: Physical Helper prepare_next calls that may expand retained measurement seed, including rollback/retry; Leader prepare_next has no XOF.
symbols.Q_i: All input/extension calls to source usage i, external/offline plus internal/recomputation. Repeated calls can count conservatively; unique descriptors separately cached.
symbols.A_i: Accepted field values materialized, separating fresh unique logical stream values from physical re-expansion work.
symbols.C_raw_i: All raw128 candidates read/generated including rejected and unused32-prefetch; re-expansion charged to physical work but same underlying raw stream reused.
symbols.B_i: Total XOF output bytes and absorb bytes per usage, including prefetch/duplicates; seed output calls are not field candidate calls.
symbols.Q_sha/B_sha: One global SHA256 invocation/byte account across every source, context/package/body/certificate/root, verifier and adversary; no per-field independent collision assumptions.
symbols.S_sig[k]: Actual signing oracle operations for each k in K_sig_X, the keys whose secret is unknown to the observer and for which arbitrary extra signing is not authorized. Cache replay not fresh sign; corrupt owner/role own keys excluded; A normal authority secret known to observer excluded because A remains correct/passive under01.
symbols.S_G16: Actual fresh simulation proof calls across full execution and related prelude, including same statement repeated freshly; count relation-family fields from02.
symbols.E: Semantic complete-cohort first exposure, <=1 per task; not reset by collection failure.
symbols.E_enc_A: Number of newly encrypted honest-role aggregate ciphertexts visible to A, including same snapshot re-encryption; not bounded by E alone.
symbols.D_hpke[k]/L_hpke[k]: Permitted decryption query and byte budgets for key k in labelled Base single-shot INDCCA2 reductions; full marked tuple excluded.
symbols.G_origin: All prepublication malicious origin reservations capable of guessing any future honest RID; not number of successful new reports.
symbols.T_all: Whole attacker and reduction executor steps, external and internal work plus bytes and rollback; normal input-ready model, no physical timing oracle.
symbols.N_RID: All honest CSPRNG RID draws/Origin reservation attempts, including failures that suppress native shard; may be bounded by public honest-slot/construct budget; not silently identified with N_shard.
symbols.G5_ext: External attacker U5 queries containing candidate16B keys, including offline and repetitions; excludes honest internal hidden-key-handle calls. G5_ext<=Q5_total<=Q_total.
symbols.kappa_tag: min(1,2^96*G5_ext/2^128,Adv_OW128_SHA256(T_ow,Q_sha+G5_ext,B_sha+16*G5_ext)); without OW primitive use information-only first two terms; uniform128bit K, public96bit deterministic tag.
symbols.T_ow: Whole C-wrapper/role/native-RO simulation plus each external U5 candidate full16B SHA check, shared RO tables and all reduction work; not attacker time alone.
